reviews.decision: Actual CCPU/SIM32 controls show an arbitrary DOS buffer need not have a contiguous host alias. Keep the existing bounded guest lease, success scatter and release on all paths. The original flush/free pair cannot release this representation.

Keep the active relative-input adapter at the original locked dispatch, reset/set-position ordering, and publication of the bounded position into the shared view read directly by original WOW16. Remove one redundant blank between local provider includes; original anchor 35 and the complete suffix retain their bytes.

Keep the minimal four scratch slots needed for simultaneous outer and nested class/title/record ownership. TLS prevents restoring a stale DDE mode sampled before task admission from another host thread. The latter is a source ordering counterexample.

Preserve explicit ownership and retirement of CB_DIR text mapping across conversion failure and exceptional unwind. Original cleanup infers ownership from the current thunk flag and cannot distinguish a rejected AddParamMap; existing lifetime tests and source analysis establish the boundary.

Keep CCPU-specific PE/CPL and cached descriptor sequencing. Original passive native CONTEXT setters and selected immediate CCPU segment loads differ. Real/protected helpers require restoring WOW page view and the continuation selectors; selected original bodies remain.

Keep original SAS dispatch with physical alias resolution. Actual CCPU page-table controls show original CPL predicates fail 24 of 90 checks; extracted fallback controls also show original IU8 cast truncation when the BIOS routine returns AX or EAX. Width proof uses stubbed paging/execution.

Retain cdecl on two idle functions. Actual WOW /Gz caller produces stdcall references under the original declarations while the worker objects export cdecl. A symbol alias would not repair stack cleanup.

Keep original internal navigation bodies and input/output discovery at the native public entrypoints. Literal original wrappers conflict with the selected definitions, and the group wrapper lacks the selected WINAPI shape.

Original CRTC start comparison ignores the cursor-off bit and cursor recomputation can overwrite the hidden state. Keep whole-register comparison and final visibility gate. Extracted original/current bitfield controls demonstrate both cases.

Owner approved preserving omission of private ntdbg.h. Both actual compile contexts reject the restoration including the LPC-header control. Existing blank preserves original subsequent line positions, and selected RaiseException calls do not need the private providers.

verification: Pinned sources and hashes, masked census, and unchanged selected executable lines and directives checked. Removed one redundant blank before the original logical-line anchor in nt_mouse.c. Selected code tokens and effective diagnostic anchors remain; nine other production files remain byte-identical. The P7 published runtime remains byte-identical to the package that passed the P10 postpublication Full run.
